_about: Prototype lesson order. Tess's plan with Lina's fixes applied. Words for each lesson live in words.json (by unlock).

lessons.title: The three strokes
teaches: ㅏ ㅓ ㅗ ㅜ built from the strokes
vertical vowels sit right, horizontal vowels sit below
lessons.goal: Hear a syllable and build it

lessons.title: Closed lips
lessons.goal: Hear ㅡ vs ㅜ; read 이모

lessons.title: The tongue tip
lessons.goal: Tell ㅁ from ㄴ; read 누나, 너무

lessons.title: Floors under the blocks
teaches: ㅁ ㄴ ㅇ as final consonants
ㅇ is silent at the start, 'ng' at the end
lessons.audio_note: TTS is unreliable on isolated syllables like 앙. Check every clip by ear or use native recordings.

lessons.title: Halmeoni's first errand
lessons.house_name_notes: Show a one-line linking hint for 민우/은우. Avoid 민아: it sounds identical to 미나.

lessons.title: The lost child at the gate

teaches: ㅑ ㅕ ㅛ ㅠ (one extra stroke each)
ㅐ and ㅔ taught as one sound

lessons.story: A boy is lost at the gate looking for his 누나. Her younger female friend calls her 언니. The rule: the speaker's gender and who is older decide the word; both are also used for older friends.
lessons.order_notes: Casual 응/아니 come first; polite 네/아니요 only after TP1b. The player's own kinship choice starts with townsperson #2.

review.counts_as_review: first attempt only, recall formats only (typing or building)

parts: Type 10 unseen syllables from audio, including nonsense syllables
Match heard words to pictures: 나/너, 문/눈, 오이/아이
Answer heard yes/no questions with 네/아니요
Say which word a boy uses and which a girl uses (누나/언니)
end_check.delayed_probe: 2 minutes, 8 random words, at next launch a day or more later; drives the progress meter
